scope: Standing main museum and the two stepped southern terraces, after the 2025 reopening at Wanping, Beijing.

originalReview.notes: The front view after reopening establishes the tiled eaves, two masonry pylons framing the raised central block, dark ribbon glazing, recessed red timber bays, and entrance terraces. Temporary people, signage, flags and sculptural plaques were excluded.

quallaSearch.notes: The exact 2025 exterior reference was already published on Qualla and its creator’s CC0 dedication was verified. Municipal heritage facts and the 2025 contractor’s account govern the approach and overall design.
